title: Agent Lifecycle Measurement Contract Register Request
description: ALR-1106 Route 2 request (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:579-624): POST /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/agent-lifecycle/measurement-contracts. The composite version-and-contract mint: the sole Part 1 minting path for kind=measurement_contract, kind=dataset_version, kind=evaluator_version, and kind=slice_definition_version -- it atomically snapshots lifecycle-owned immutable membership from either a scoped Backend resource (backend_registered) or a bounded content-free client-attested declaration (client_attested), then binds all three into one immutable MeasurementContract in the same transaction. No expected-count, denominator, or completeness field of any kind appears anywhere in this closed request (additionalProperties:false rejects one outright, corpus case measurement_contract_register_client_supplied_denominator_rejected) -- Backend computes expected_count exclusively from the accepted immutable membership in the response. `Idempotency-Key` (required header, same pattern/mechanism as Route 1) is a request HEADER, out of this document's scope (service_invalid case measurement_contract_register_missing_idempotency_key). `mode=ITEM_KEY_SET` is admissible only when dataset_source.source=client_attested (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:594, closes Opus Final Contract Review P1-2) -- encoded below as an if/then across the two sibling top-level properties (schema-decidable; corpus case measurement_contract_register_item_key_set_with_backend_registered_dataset). `StableSourceRef`, `ClientAttestedArtifactDescriptor`, and `RequestOnlyRandomLabel` live in agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json (added there in this pass, reused rather than duplicated per the contract's request-only wire-type section, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:313-325). None of source_ref/local_version_key/item_keys is ever echoed by this route or exposed in an error, URL, log, analytics event, telemetry event, export, or idempotency replay (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:596). Every property below carries its own x-disclosure annotation at its own JSON Pointer (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:406-409, :412-431).

dataset_source.description: Closed oneOf: backend_registered (an existing scoped Backend dataset, resolved through the discovery-issued StableSourceRef mapping) or client_attested (a bounded content-free membership declaration) (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:592).

source_ref.description: source_ref.kind=dataset; request-only opaque handle, never evidence identity (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:592).

item_keys.description: Non-empty, unique, maxItems=10000 (beta ceiling), content-free (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:592). corpus case measurement_contract_register_item_keys_empty proves the minItems floor.

items.description: RequestOnlyItemKey grammar: exactly RequestOnlyRandomLabel (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:317). corpus case measurement_contract_register_item_key_digest_shaped proves the digest-shaped exclusion.

evaluator_source.description: Closed oneOf: backend_registered (an existing scoped Backend evaluator, resolved through the discovery-issued StableSourceRef mapping) or client_attested (a bounded content-free version declaration, no item_keys -- evaluators have no membership dimension) (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:593).

source_ref.description: source_ref.kind=evaluator; request-only opaque handle, never evidence identity (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:593).

slice_definition.description: Closed oneOf: FULL_DATASET (selects all accepted items) or ITEM_KEY_SET (a client-nameable subset, admissible only over a client_attested dataset_source -- see the root if/then below) (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:594).

item_keys.description: Non-empty, unique, maxItems=10000; must resolve to a subset of the accepted DatasetVersion's own membership (service_invalid, corpus case measurement_contract_register_slice_item_keys_not_subset_of_dataset) (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:594).
